{"decision": "ALLOW", "matched_rule": "FS-LOCAL", "reason": "Bounded local capability allowed.", "executed": true, "execution_status": "succeeded", "effect_status": "none", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

BINARY=(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'build/minidb')

class DatabaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        # All child test files stay in the sandbox workspace.
        test_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'build/test-data'
        test_root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='db-test-',dir=test_root)
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path=Path(self.temp.name)

    def run_db(self, commands):
        return subprocess.run([str(BINARY)],input=commands,cwd=self.path,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=3)

    def test_insert_select_and_restart(self):
        self.assertIn('Executed.',self.run_db('insert 1 alice\n.exit\n').stdout)
        result=self.run_db('select\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertIn('(1, alice)',result.stdout)

    def test_zero_and_uint32_max(self):
        result=self.run_db('insert 0 zero\ninsert 4294967295 max\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertIn('(0, zero)',result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('(4294967295, max)',result.stdout)

    def test_duplicate_preserves_row(self):
        result=self.run_db('insert 3 first\ninsert 3 second\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertIn('duplicate',result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('(3, second)',result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('(3, first)',result.stdout)

    def test_count_empty_is_read_only(self):
        result=self.run_db('count\ncount\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Count: 0\nCount: 0\n')
        self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db').exists())

    def test_count_zero_duplicates_and_restart(self):
        result=self.run_db('count\ninsert 0 zero\ncount\ninsert 0 other\ncount\ninsert 4294967295 max\ncount\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Count: 0','Executed.','Count: 1','Error: duplicate id.',
            'Count: 1','Executed.','Count: 2'])
        expected=(b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',2)+struct.pack('<I32s',0,b'zero')
                  +struct.pack('<I32s',4294967295,b'max'))
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),expected)
        result=self.run_db('count\ninsert 0 other\ncount\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Count: 2','Error: duplicate id.','Count: 2',
            '(0, zero)','(4294967295, max)','Executed.'])
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),expected)

    def test_count_existing_binary_format(self):
        data=b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',1)+struct.pack('<I32s',0,b'legacy')
        (self.path/'data.db').write_bytes(data)
        result=self.run_db('count\nselect\ncount extra\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Count: 1','(0, legacy)','Executed.','Error: invalid statement.'])
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),data)

    def test_invalid_input_never_creates_database(self):
        result=self.run_db('insert -1 bad\ninsert 4294967296 bad\ninsert 1 '+'a'*32+'\ninsert 2 ok extra\ninsert 1x bad\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count('invalid statement'),5)
        self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db').exists())

    def test_capacity_and_eof(self):
        result=self.run_db(''.join(f'insert {i} row{i}\n' for i in range(101)))
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count('Executed.'),100)
        self.assertIn('table full',result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)

    def test_corrupt_and_truncated_data_rejected(self):
        for data in [b'bad',b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',101),b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',1)+b'broken',b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',0)+b'extra']:
            (self.path/'data.db').write_bytes(data)
            result=self.run_db('select\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,1)
            self.assertIn('invalid database',result.stderr)

    def test_overlong_input_recovery(self):
        result=self.run_db('x'*5000+'\ninsert 1 ok\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertIn('input too long',result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('(1, ok)',result.stdout)

    def test_persistence_failure_is_reported_and_rolled_back(self):
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').mkdir()
        result=self.run_db('insert 1 nope\nselect\ncount\n.exit\n')
        self.assertIn('persistence failed',result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('(1, nope)',result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('Count: 0\n',result.stdout)
        self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db').exists())

    def test_delete_zero_middle_last_and_restart(self):
        result=self.run_db('insert 0 zero\ninsert 7 seven\ninsert 2 two\ninsert 4294967295 max\ndelete 0\ncount\nselect\ndelete 2\ncount\nselect\ndelete 4294967295\ncount\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Executed.','Executed.','Executed.','Executed.','Executed.',
            'Count: 3','(7, seven)','(2, two)','(4294967295, max)','Executed.',
            'Executed.','Count: 2','(7, seven)','(4294967295, max)','Executed.',
            'Executed.','Count: 1','(7, seven)','Executed.'])
        expected=b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',1)+struct.pack('<I32s',7,b'seven')
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),expected)
        result=self.run_db('count\nselect\ndelete 7\ncount\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Count: 1','(7, seven)','Executed.','Executed.','Count: 0','Executed.'])
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',0))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_db('count\nselect\n').stdout,'Count: 0\nExecuted.\n')

    def test_delete_missing_is_read_only(self):
        result=self.run_db('delete 0\ncount\nselect\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Error: no such id.\nCount: 0\nExecuted.\n')
        self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db').exists())
        self.run_db('insert 8 eight\n')
        before=(self.path/'data.db').read_bytes()
        result=self.run_db('delete 0\ndelete 4294967295\ncount\nselect\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Error: no such id.','Error: no such id.','Count: 1','(8, eight)','Executed.'])
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),before)
        self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db.tmp').exists())

    def test_delete_malformed_arguments(self):
        self.run_db('insert 0 zero\n')
        before=(self.path/'data.db').read_bytes()
        invalid=['delete','delete -1','delete +0','delete 4294967296',
                 'delete 1x','delete 0 extra','delete 0 extra more',
                 'delete '+'9'*40,'delete 0.0']
        result=self.run_db('\n'.join(invalid)+'\ncount\nselect\n.help\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines()[:len(invalid)],
                         ['Error: invalid statement.']*len(invalid))
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines()[len(invalid):len(invalid)+3],
                         ['Count: 1','(0, zero)','Executed.'])
        self.assertIn('delete <uint32 id>',result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),before)

    def test_delete_persistence_failure_preserves_memory_and_disk(self):
        self.run_db('insert 0 zero\ninsert 9 nine\ninsert 3 three\n')
        before=(self.path/'data.db').read_bytes()
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').mkdir()
        result=self.run_db('delete 9\ncount\nselect\ndelete 99\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Error: persistence failed.','Count: 3','(0, zero)',
            '(9, nine)','(3, three)','Executed.','Error: no such id.'])
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),before)
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').rmdir()
        result=self.run_db('count\nselect\ndelete 9\ncount\nselect\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Count: 3','(0, zero)','(9, nine)','(3, three)','Executed.',
            'Executed.','Count: 2','(0, zero)','(3, three)','Executed.'])


    def test_find_empty_is_read_only(self):
        result=self.run_db('find 0\nfind 4294967295\ncount\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Not found.\nNot found.\nCount: 0\n')
        self.assertEqual(list(self.path.iterdir()),[])

    def test_find_repeated_queries_and_restart_preserve_database(self):
        # Noncanonical padding makes an accidental rewrite visible in bytes.
        data=(b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',3)
              +struct.pack('<I',7)+b'seven\0'+b'x'*26
              +struct.pack('<I32s',0,b'zero')
              +struct.pack('<I32s',4294967295,b'max'))
        database=self.path/'data.db'
        database.write_bytes(data)
        before=database.stat()
        commands=('find 4294967295\nfind 7\nfind 0\nfind 8\n'*3
                  +'count\nselect\n.exit\n')
        expected=(['(4294967295, max)','(7, seven)','(0, zero)','Not found.']*3
                  +['Count: 3','(7, seven)','(0, zero)','(4294967295, max)','Executed.'])
        for _ in range(2):
            result=self.run_db(commands)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),expected)
            self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),data)
            self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_mtime_ns,before.st_mtime_ns)
            self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_ino,before.st_ino)
            self.assertEqual(sorted(p.name for p in self.path.iterdir()),['data.db'])
        # A blocked save path must not affect lookup.
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').mkdir()
        result=self.run_db('find 7\nfind 8\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'(7, seven)\nNot found.\n')
        self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),data)
        self.assertTrue((self.path/'data.db.tmp').is_dir())

    def test_find_malformed_arguments(self):
        invalid=['find','find -1','find +0','find 4294967296',
                 'find 1x','find 0 extra','find 0 extra more',
                 'find '+'9'*40,'find 0.0','find 0x0']
        for populated in (False,True):
            if populated:
                self.assertEqual(self.run_db('insert 0 zero\n').returncode,0)
            before=(self.path/'data.db').read_bytes() if populated else None
            result=self.run_db('\n'.join(invalid)+'\ncount\n.help\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines()[:len(invalid)],
                             ['Error: invalid statement.']*len(invalid))
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines()[len(invalid)],
                             'Count: 1' if populated else 'Count: 0')
            self.assertIn('find <uint32 id>',result.stdout)
            if populated:
                self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),before)
            else:
                self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db').exists())
            self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db.tmp').exists())

    def test_find_coexists_with_insert_delete(self):
        result=self.run_db('find 7\ninsert 7 seven\nfind 7\ninsert 0 zero\n'
                           'insert 7 other\nfind 7\ndelete 7\nfind 7\n'
                           'delete 7\nfind 0\ninsert 7 new\nfind 7\ncount\nselect\n.exit\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Not found.','Executed.','(7, seven)','Executed.',
            'Error: duplicate id.','(7, seven)','Executed.','Not found.',
            'Error: no such id.','(0, zero)','Executed.','(7, new)',
            'Count: 2','(0, zero)','(7, new)','Executed.'])
        result=self.run_db('find 7\nfind 0\ncount\nselect\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            '(7, new)','(0, zero)','Count: 2','(0, zero)','(7, new)','Executed.'])


    def test_rename_first_middle_last_and_restart(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_db('insert 0 zero\ninsert 7 middle\ninsert 4294967295 max\n').returncode,0)
        names=['a'*31,'m','last']
        for row_id,name in zip([0,7,4294967295],names):
            result=self.run_db(f'rename {row_id} {name}\nfind {row_id}\ncount\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),
                             ['Executed.',f'({row_id}, {name})','Count: 3'])
        expected=(b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',3)
                  +b''.join(struct.pack('<I32s',i,n.encode()) for i,n in
                            zip([0,7,4294967295],names)))
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),expected)
        result=self.run_db('find 0\nfind 7\nfind 4294967295\nselect\ncount\n.help\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        rows=[f'({i}, {n})' for i,n in zip([0,7,4294967295],names)]
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines()[:-1],rows+rows+['Executed.','Count: 3'])
        self.assertIn('rename <uint32 id> <new-name>',result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual((self.path/'data.db').read_bytes(),expected)

    def test_rename_missing_and_malformed_do_not_mutate(self):
        invalid=['rename','rename 0','rename 0   ','rename -1 name',
                 'rename +0 name','rename 4294967296 name','rename 1x name',
                 'rename '+'9'*40+' name','rename 0.0 name',
                 'rename 0 '+'a'*32,'rename 0 '+'é'*16,
                 'rename 0 new extra','rename 0 two words']
        for populated in (False,True):
            if populated:
                self.assertEqual(self.run_db('insert 0 original\n').returncode,0)
            database=self.path/'data.db'
            before=database.read_bytes() if populated else None
            result=self.run_db('\n'.join(invalid)+'\nrename 8 name\nrename 4294967295 name\ncount\nselect\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),
                             ['Error: invalid statement.']*len(invalid)
                             +['Error: no such id.']*2
                             +(['Count: 1','(0, original)','Executed.'] if populated
                               else ['Count: 0','Executed.']))
            if populated:
                self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),before)
            else:
                self.assertFalse(database.exists())
            self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db.tmp').exists())

    def test_rename_persistence_failure_rolls_back_memory_and_disk(self):
        self.run_db('insert 0 zero\ninsert 9 original\ninsert 4294967295 max\n')
        database=self.path/'data.db'
        before=database.read_bytes()
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').mkdir()
        result=self.run_db('rename 9 changed\nfind 9\ncount\nselect\nrename 9 x\nfind 9\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Error: persistence failed.','(9, original)','Count: 3',
            '(0, zero)','(9, original)','(4294967295, max)','Executed.',
            'Error: persistence failed.','(9, original)'])
        self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),before)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_db('find 9\ncount\n').stdout,'(9, original)\nCount: 3\n')
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').rmdir()
        result=self.run_db('rename 9 recovered\nfind 9\ncount\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Executed.\n(9, recovered)\nCount: 3\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_db('find 9\n').stdout,'(9, recovered)\n')


    def test_clear_rows_queries_restart_and_repeat(self):
        result=self.run_db('insert 0 zero\ninsert 7 seven\ninsert 4294967295 max\nclear\ncount\nselect\nfind 0\nfind 7\nfind 4294967295\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Executed.']*4+['Count: 0','Executed.']+['Not found.']*3)
        database=self.path/'data.db'
        empty=b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',0)
        self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),empty)
        before=database.stat()
        # Block persistence to prove repeated clear never attempts a save.
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').mkdir()
        result=self.run_db('count\nselect\nfind 7\nclear\nclear\ncount\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Count: 0','Executed.','Not found.','Executed.','Executed.','Count: 0'])
        self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),empty)
        self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_mtime_ns,before.st_mtime_ns)
        self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_ino,before.st_ino)
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').rmdir()
        result=self.run_db('insert 7 new\nfind 7\ncount\nselect\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Executed.','(7, new)','Count: 1','(7, new)','Executed.'])

    def test_clear_initially_empty_is_read_only(self):
        result=self.run_db('clear\nclear\ncount\nselect\nfind 0\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(),[
            'Executed.','Executed.','Count: 0','Executed.','Not found.'])
        self.assertEqual(list(self.path.iterdir()),[])
        (self.path/'data.db.tmp').mkdir()
        result=self.run_db('clear\ncount\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Executed.\nCount: 0\n')
        self.assertEqual([p.name for p in self.path.iterdir()],['data.db.tmp'])

    def test_clear_extra_arguments_are_invalid(self):
        invalid=['clear 0','clear extra','clear extra more','clear '+'x'*100]
        for populated in (False,True):
            if populated:
                self.assertEqual(self.run_db('insert 0 zero\n').returncode,0)
            database=self.path/'data.db'
            before=database.read_bytes() if populated else None
            result=self.run_db('\n'.join(invalid)+'\ncount\nselect\n.help\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines()[:-1],
                             ['Error: invalid statement.']*len(invalid)
                             +(['Count: 1','(0, zero)','Executed.'] if populated
                               else ['Count: 0','Executed.']))
            self.assertIn('; clear;',result.stdout)
            if populated:
                self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),before)
            else:
                self.assertFalse(database.exists())

        database=self.path/'data.db'
        data=b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',0)

        before=database.stat()
        for _ in range(2):
            result=self.run_db('stats\nstats\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Rows: 0/100\nAvailable: 100\n'*2)
            self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),data)
            self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_mtime_ns,before.st_mtime_ns)
            self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_ino,before.st_ino)

        # Preserve noncanonical padding to detect an accidental save.
        data=(b'GDB1'+struct.pack('<I',2)

        database=self.path/'data.db'
        database.write_bytes(data)
        before=database.stat()
        for _ in range(2):
            result=self.run_db('stats\nstats\nfind 7\ncount\n')

            self.assertEqual(database.stat().st_ino,before.st_ino)
            self.assertEqual([p.name for p in self.path.iterdir()],['data.db'])

        before=database.read_bytes()
        for _ in range(2):
            result=self.run_db('stats\nstats\n')

            self.assertEqual(result.stdout,'Rows: 100/100\nAvailable: 0\n'*2)
            self.assertEqual(database.read_bytes(),before)
            self.assertFalse((self.path/'data.db.tmp').exists())
